# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and university student  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Prissy  <sub>[v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>; Pris  <sub>[v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with brown eyes and lovely hair. She is tall, standing a good two inches taller than most people in a crowd. During her college days, she is described as golden and fair.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Despite her pale, spiritual appearance, Priscilla is full of mischief, fun, and pranks. She possesses a poetic and dreamy mind, often sharing imaginative thoughts about nature and life with her friends. She is ambitious and thoughtful, yet retains a mischievous streak, such as poking gentle fun at acquaintances. She holds strong personal aspirations and values close female friendships deeply.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v3 c4 P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy in Charlottetown, where she formed a close friendship with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. After completing her studies at Queen's, she was engaged to teach school at Carmody for a year before returning to teach at her home school. During this period, she visited Avonlea, participated in meetings for the Avonlea Village Improvement Society—writing papers for the group—and introduced her aunt, the famous writer Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, to her friends. Later, upon gaining her father's consent, Priscilla enrolled alongside Anne at Redmond College in Kingsport, where the two shared a boardinghouse. During their second year at college, Priscilla, Anne, Stella, and Philippa Gordon rented Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, keeping house together under the care of Stella's Aunt Jamesina. Priscilla completed her degree at Redmond, reflecting on how much her college experience broadened her appreciation of life.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 c10 P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_
